name: Camera Ray Projection
aliases: Camera Ray Projection — Inverse Projection with Distortion
Pixel to Ray Conversion with Distortion
Ray Casting with Distortion and NDC Support
definition: Converts pixel coordinates to world-space rays using camera intrinsic and extrinsic parameters, including distortion correction.
summary: Camera Ray Projection maps distorted pixel coordinates to undistorted world-space rays by solving a non-linear system via Newton-Raphson iteration, unlike forward projection's direct algebraic transformation.
